_comment: Row 747 M1. Anchor is ZERO-WIDTH on the decision -- it consumes nothing, so no value-bearing token is inside the matched span, and the mutation is an INSERTION that really executes. Two earlier shapes were measured and rejected: putting the digit in a LOOKAHEAD while substituting `return 0` does not consume it, so the mutant read `return 02`, never parsed, and bd-mutate reported INVALID (never ran) rather than CAUGHT; and CONSUMING `return \d` does parse but makes the anchor value-bearing, which tests/test_row357_mutant_anchors_are_not_fragile.py REFUSES as UNKNOWN (measured: 'contains value-bearing source text, but no producer or audited stable exception establishes its class'). This shape is the one row667 _transform_control uses: zero-width lookbehind/lookahead on the structure, insertion as `new`.
